_about: 2-Butanone (1) + Methanol (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.3 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of 2-butanone, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of 2-butanone, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: Z. Li, Q. Li, R. Qiao, K. Zhang, X. Song, C. Li, H. Tang, Y. Liu, Isobaric vapor-liquid equilibrium for methanol + methyl ethyl ketone + bis(trifluoromethylsulfonyl)imide-based ionic liquids at 101.3 kPa, Fluid Phase Equilib. 427 (2016) 90-96
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 1, 2. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.0066. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.33 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
